description: Permanently delete one item that is already in the trash, with its shares, votes and version history. It cannot be undone and only works on trashed items; to hide something reversibly use driftnet_update_item with trashed=true. Confirm with the reader first. Fails if the item does not exist or is not in the trash.

id.description: Id of a trashed item (driftnet_search_items with view 'trash'), a positive integer such as 42

name: driftnet_delete_item
title: Delete a trashed item for good
